tool.name: SplitSegmentsAtConnectors
tool.summary: Split segment polylines at connector point geometries listed in the connectors JSON field. Each segment is split into sub-segments between consecutive connector positions, producing one new polyline feature per pair of adjacent connectors. Features with fewer than three connectors (start and end only) are left untouched.

usage.bullet_item: The input segment features must be polylines containing a connectors text field with JSON-encoded connector references from Overture Maps.
The connector features must be a point layer with an id field matching the connector identifiers in the segments.
A search radius of 10 meters is used by default to snap connector points to the segment geometry.
If an Output Features path is provided, the input data is copied before splitting and the original features are not modified.

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The polyline feature layer or feature class containing an Overture connectors field to use for splitting.

param.name: connector_features
param.dialogReference: The point feature layer or feature class containing Overture connector features with an id field.

param.name: output_features
param.dialogReference: Optional output feature class. When provided, the input features are copied here before splitting and the original data is left untouched.
